prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-10-30, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-10-30):
| Current ratio           | 0.62 |
| Retained earnings       | 36,115M |
| Current liabilities     | 8,286M |
| Current assets          | 5,119M |
| Shareholders' equity    | -2,646M |
| Total liabilities       | 37,604M |
| Total assets            | 35,008M |
| EBIT / operating income | 3,230M |
| Revenue                 | 5,251M |
Return ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {{"decision": "<one label>", "confidence": <integer 1-5>, "rationale": "<=25 words"}}
raw_response: {"decision": "CCC-", "confidence": 3, "rationale": "Severe distress: negative equity, liabilities exceed assets, weak liquidity (current ratio 0.62), high default risk despite EBIT."}
